text: # Refund Policy Refunds are issued to the original payment method. ## Approval Thresholds - Refunds of $100 or less: automatically approved by the agent. - Refunds over $100: require human approval before processing. ## Processing Time - Credit card refunds: 5-10 business days. - Store credit: instant. ## Exceptions - Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the item arrived damaged. - Refunds are issued in the same currency as the original purchase. ## Multi-Tenant Note Each tenant has its own order history. An agent may only view and refund orders belonging to the tenant it is serving.

# Return Policy Customers may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. ## Eligibility - Item must be in original condition with packaging. - Proof of purchase (order ID) is required. - Digital goods and gift cards are non-returnable. ## Process 1. Customer contacts support with order ID. 2. Agent verifies order status via check_order_status. 3. If eligible, agent initiates return or refund.
